# UsedCarsNZ

> UsedCarsNZ (usedcarsnz.co.nz) is a New Zealand used-car co-listing platform for dealers. Dealers keep their Trade Me listing and add UsedCarsNZ; every buyer enquiry gets a first response in under 60 seconds, is qualified by a clearly labelled AI assistant, and is handed to the dealer as a warm lead. Dealer replies are approved by the dealer before they are sent, and response-time and conversion results are measured and published.

UsedCarsNZ currently runs a free Founding Dealer pilot for New Zealand dealerships. It is not affiliated with Trade Me.

## Main pages

- [Home / Founding Dealer Program](https://usedcarsnz.co.nz/): what UsedCarsNZ does for dealers and how to join the pilot
- [Browse cars](https://usedcarsnz.co.nz/cars): used cars listed by participating New Zealand dealers
- [The number we publish](https://usedcarsnz.co.nz/metrics): public response-time and conversion metrics
- [Privacy](https://usedcarsnz.co.nz/privacy): how buyer and dealer data is handled under the NZ Privacy Act 2020

## Optional
